instruction.text: Miss Wilson’s bag has been taken. She wants to know about the person who took it. Fill in the gap.

atoms.b: She asks '((++Who Why When)) took my bag?'

wrong.text: Remember that if we want to know about a person, we use the question word who.

atoms.text: The children think that it could be Joey, because he went home early.

instruction.text: Miss Wilson wants to know about the time that Joey left. Fill in the gap.

atoms.b: She asks '((Where What ++When)) did he leave?'

wrong.text: Remember that if we want to know about a time, we use the question word when.

atoms.text: The children say that he only left ten minutes ago.

instruction.text: Miss Wilson wants to find out the place Joey is. Drag the letters to spell the word.
Miss Wilson wants to find out the reason that Joey took her bag. Drag the letters to spell the word.

atoms.text: Joey explains that he has the same bag as Miss Wilson. This is his bag!

atoms.a: Then, how can I find my bag?
atoms.b: Then ((how)) can I find my bag?

wrong.text: Miss Wilson is asking about the way that she can find her bag, so we use the question word 'how'.

atoms.text: Joey says that he saw another bag outside.

atoms.a: What is that on the ground?

wrong.text: Miss Wilson is asking about the thing that is on the ground, so the question word is 'what'.

atoms.sound: ssml: It’s Miss Wilson’s bag! <break time='1000ms'/>

atoms.text: Thank you for helping her find it.
